profile.headline: Senior \​ Lead \​ Principal \​ SDET \​ Software QA Automation \​ SQA Manager | Financial QA | Automation guru and tool builder | Quality Process Architect -- I elevate engineering organizations! | US Citizen
profile.summary:
I've completed over two decades in software/high tech; 1 year as a developer in video games.  The rest, 25 years, as a SDET/Automated Software QA, using tools like Silk Test, Silk Performer, UFT, Mercury LoadRunner and QuickTestPro.  Scripting in Selenium/Selenium Web Driver, python, Java, JavaScript, C/C++/C#, perl, fitnesse.  I've also been in many lead positions:  QA Manager (5 years) and interim v.p. development (2 months), QA Principal (5 years), Team Lead (8 years).

Other than manual testing, which I highly value because this helps me "get my hands dirty" and delve into the product, I have done a lot of automation and creating tools for various groups. Additionally, I've been the DBA for the QA group, and I've been the Performance Lead Engineer.

Specialties: Software Quality Assurance, Automation, Software Quality Methodology, Performance Testing (Stress, Limit, Performance).

As I'm beginning to get international recruiters, please understand the United States is large. No, I cannot onsite or hybrid unless it's somewhere between Boston and New York.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Working for the Equity Derivatives group (Equity Swaps/Structured Productions, Equity Derivatives):

* Creating automation framework for simulating bulk upload of Equity swaps as well as generation of FIX messages for various customers
* capacity test lead: created automation for deployment to test environments, log scraping, aggregation of data

Specific accomplishments:
* created a way to one-click start the system including accounting for dependencies and checking multiple conditions
* parsing/scraping over 200 logs to aggregate exceptions and errors as well as generating service startup time
* generating data visualizations from above data (establishing we can handle more than 2x production levels without re-configuration and more than 2x production levels with minor reconfiguration)
* real-time parsing of logs handled asynchronously (asyncio gather)
* DevOps automated deployment/transforms for multiple environments and products including full deploy and 1+ service deploy (greatly reducing time for deployment through parallelization: 2-3 hours down to 15-60 minutes (Equity Swaps); 4 hours to 10 minutes (Distributed Calculations); 4-5 hours to 30 minutes for EMEA Derivatives).

positions.title: QA Manager (contract)
positions.description:
Technical QA Manager for HealthTouch: a stand-alone windows application migrating to web-based/SaaS version and web-based administration portal integrating meal ordering for hospitals' food providers.
* managed 4 onshore engineers and 2-4 offshore engineers (scaling up/down as necessary)
* As a manager/project manager, I deal with schedules, estimate test effort, craft quality plans, test strategies, test planning, patch planning, resource allocation
* Automation: assessed appropriateness of some different tools (Katalon, Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, Silk, Visual Studio with Endpoint Explorer) and alignment with current technologies
* maintained, developed API and UI automation (Silk, java, Postman-newman)
* performed some manual testing for regression and new features and developed test cases
* some technologies used: Azure, SQL Server, SilkTest, postman, newman, CI/CD pipelines, git, React (React.js), jira and xray
positions.insights: Skills: Test Automation · Silk Test · Postman · Quality Assurance Management · Microsoft Azure · Git · Product Quality · Quality Engineering · Team Management · Test Estimation · Test Effort Estimation · Test Data · Visual Studio · Presenting Solutions · React.js

positions.title: QA Engineer/SDET
positions.description:
Technical QA (Automation Engineer)/SDET role for Portfolio Finance and previously Trading Systems team.

* ETL (loading multiple BOD files for multiple banks and validating data and calculations)
* API automation (Swagger, Python; BDD)
* AWS: Lambda, CloudWatch, DynamoDB, s3, awscli
* validation of third-party broker data including BOD calculations and Cloud migration
* automation of some proprietary products including pythonnet-Python-C# DLLs (automated evaluation of holdings and financial models using pythonnet and legacy C# DLL)

Previously on the Trading Systems team:
* created Python to parse FIX Files to English (Excel output)
* created difference engine in python (pandas dataframes, numpy) for CRIMS input/output files and created front end UI in tkinter
* primary QA for CRIMS upgrade and tested in-house plugins and business workflows
* created UI automation via Appium for CRIMS workflows
* created Excel with VBA to create CRIMS order and execution files
positions.insights: Skills: AWS Command Line Interface (CLI) · Pandas (Software) · CRIMS · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python (Programming Language) · Appium · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Selenium · Problem Solving · Front-End Development · Test Data · Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) · REST APIs · Presentations · Technical Presentations · Zephyr · Code Review · Knowledge Sharing

positions.title: Principal QA Engineer
positions.description:
I first worked on ITG's OMS/EMS system, Triton X, the next generation trading and order management platform (2007-2009) and then more recently a single-stock and list-based EMS platform implemented in Visual C# + WPF, Triton Black.

Triton X (June 2007-December 2009):
* interim team lead (4 months)
* scripting in Excel VB, fitnesse, java, MSDOS, perl, SQL
* DBA for my group (Microsoft SQL Server)
* testing all facets of equity trading and position management/accounting

Triton Black (Jan 2010 - present)
* DBA for my group (Microsoft SQL Server)
* scripting in Excel VB, fitnesse, java, MSDOS, perl, python, SQL Server
* testing single-stock and list-based trading platform, for equities, equity options, including calculations for Greeks; futures, real-time foreign exchange streaming, and fixed income
* QA Lead: coordinated State Street's FX Connect Integration with Triton Black as well as Fixed Income initiative
* Performance QA Lead
* rotated as scrum master (every six months)
positions.insights: Skills: Jira · Microsoft SQL Server · Python (Programming Language) · SQL · FitNesse · Scrum Master · Communication · Technical Communication · Team Leadership · Technical Leadereship · Performance Improvement · Key Performance Indicators · Performance Engineering · Presentations · Financial Applications · Technical Design

positions.title: QA Manager
positions.description:
Sungard BancWare is an international financial institution that helps model fixed income securities and cash flow of positions to help identify interest rate risk.  Based in Boston, Massachusetts, with offices in New York, London, and Singapore, Bancware has over 500 clients of many top international banks.

* managed team of 7 QA engineers; managed test planning, test strategy, wrote process documents
* acting Project Manager for the technology (development and QA) team, and occasionally visited clients at their sites to deal with their issues. (Split of my time was 10% project management, 5-10% product management, 10-20% personnel management and client relations, and the rest, about 60% was technical QA work (testing, setting up process, etc.)
* interim VP of Development for 2 months while my manager was on maternity leave
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft SQL Server · SQL · SilkTest · Quality Assurance Management · Client Relations · Distributed Systems · Requirements Analysis · Project Management · Quality Engineering · Quality System · Testing Practices · Engineering Management · Defining Product Requirements · Defining Requirements

positions.title: QA Engineer, Automation Team
positions.description:
Charles River Development produces a multi-tiered order management system. Version 7 was written in Powerbuilder, Version 8 is a combination of Java, C#, and PB.  Charles River Compliance was ranked the top Compliance System 2005 by Global Investor magazine and Waters.

•	Inherited and expanded SilkTest scripts for Batch compliance and GUI compliance product, working with customer databases (Sybase, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle) from 1 client database to 22 and stabilizing 14 tests to create over 125 GUI workflows and tests for Compliance
•	Maintained QA Databases and DB servers as Database Administrator:  creation of schemas, adding/dropping tablespaces, users, datafiles, loading/dropping customer databases
•	maintained customer database upgrades
•	Performance work with Grinder on webreporting, as well as gathering of performance metrics.
•	Coordinated/chaired performance team
•	Wrote java-based tool comparing two different tables to determine differences between different significant digits (for validating concentration calculations)
positions.insights: Skills: Oracle Database · Java · CRIMS · Sybase · SilkTest · Silk Performer · Microsoft SQL Server · Test Suites · Programming

positions.description:
